hooks.command: $raw = if ($env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT) { $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT } elseif ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; if (-not $raw) { exit 0 }; $d = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = if ($d.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'tool_input') { $d.tool_input.file_path } else { $d.file_path }; $root = if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { $env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR } else { $PWD.Path }; $py = Join-Path $root '.venv\Scripts\python.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $py)) { $py = 'python' }; if ($f -and $f.EndsWith('.py') -and $f.StartsWith($root)) { & $py -m black $f 2>&1; & $py -m isort $f 2>&1 }

$raw = if ($env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT) { $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT } elseif ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; if (-not $raw) { exit 0 }; $d = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = if ($d.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'tool_input') { $d.tool_input.file_path } else { $d.file_path }; if ($f -and $f -match 'Dashboard[/\\]src') { npm run lint:js 2>&1 }

$raw = if ($env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT) { $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT } elseif ([Console]::IsInputRedirected) { [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() }; if (-not $raw) { exit 0 }; $d = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = if ($d.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'tool_input') { $d.tool_input.file_path } else { $d.file_path }; $blocked = @('.env', 'automacoes.db', 'orchestrator.db', 'orchestrator.pid', 'worker.pid'); foreach ($b in $blocked) { if ($f -and $f.EndsWith($b)) { Write-Error "BLOQUEADO: arquivo sensivel nao pode ser editado pelo agente: $f"; exit 2 } }
